# Mick Robbins

Mick Robbins has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/17/former-policeman-joins-election-beat-please-change/)\]
